summary: @ornikar/repo-config-react preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (oven-sh/bun) into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and then invokes it against a 727KB sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscated: hex-mangled identifiers (e.g. `_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and per-function proxy tables (`{ SBBJg: 'bun', dAZFw: 'bun.exe',... }`) hide literals such as `bun`, `ldd`, `/etc/os-release`, `Alpine`, and the Bun release URL. `math_init.js` is a Bun-CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with a rotated string array and character-decoder function — its behavior is not inspectable as source and it is executable only under the just-downloaded Bun binary, not under Node. The package is advertised as a shared React repo-config and has no functional need for a second language runtime. Alternate-runtime execution of an opaque, obfuscated payload at install time evades Node-based static and dynamic analysis and runs arbitrary attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine during `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
